summary.zh-CN: Agent Runtime 可以获得更有用的 NextClaw 上下文，富内容更容易查看和复用，排队消息也不再重复出现。
summary.en-US: Agent Runtimes gain more useful NextClaw context, rich content is easier to inspect and reuse, and queued messages no longer appear twice.

body.zh-CN: Codex 与 Claude Code Runtime 会保留原生指令，同时获得 NextClaw 产品说明、工作区上下文和 skill 信息。
body.en-US: Codex and Claude Code Runtimes keep their native instructions while receiving NextClaw product guidance, workspace context, and skill information.

body.zh-CN: 上下文注入默认开启，并可通过 nextclaw agents runtime config 按 runtime 查询或修改。
body.en-US: Context injection is enabled by default and can be inspected or changed per runtime with nextclaw agents runtime config.

body.zh-CN: Panel App 与 HTML 内容可以通过只读的 window.nextclaw.params 获取结构化运行参数。
body.en-US: Panel Apps and HTML content can read structured runtime data from the read-only window.nextclaw.params object.

body.zh-CN: 聊天中的 Mermaid 图表可以全屏查看，并通过关闭按钮、遮罩或 Escape 键退出。
body.en-US: Mermaid diagrams in chat can open full screen and close through the button, backdrop, or Escape key.

body.zh-CN: 当比较、流程、层级或数值关系更适合视觉表达时，Agent 会更主动地选择紧凑表格或 Mermaid 图示。
body.en-US: Agents are more likely to choose a compact table or Mermaid diagram when comparisons, flows, hierarchies, or numeric relationships benefit from visual presentation.

body.zh-CN: 排队消息会等到真正开始执行后再进入会话记录，不再同时出现在待发队列和聊天时间线中。
body.en-US: Queued messages enter the conversation only when execution begins instead of appearing in both the pending queue and chat timeline.

body.zh-CN: 现有 NPM 安装可以直接通过 stable 通道升级，不需要迁移配置、会话或文件。
body.en-US: Existing npm installations can update through the stable channel without migrating configuration, sessions, or files.
